name: Catnip Cartel
source:
Catnip Cartel is a visual novel game set in the 1950s, where cats roamed the streets, looking to make a name for themselves. Play as the mafia leader of the gang that invented Catnip and make choices that will impact how you’re remembered in the grand course of history. 

[From [url=https://cuongnguyen2211.itch.io/catnip-cartel]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Catnip Cartel》是一款以20世纪50年代为背景的视觉小说。那时猫咪在街头游荡，努力闯出名堂。你将扮演发明了猫薄荷的帮派头目，并做出影响自己将如何载入史册的选择。

[来源：[url=https://cuongnguyen2211.itch.io/catnip-cartel]Itch.io[/url]]
